body:
Commit 8e34c38 (EmilyOS), e59743810 (top-level monorepo, sudo-queue/76). Founder direction: install an Alpine-based Raspberry Pi distro, in the EmilyOS repo, with EmilyOS becoming the real distro (confirmed directly, not guessed). Resolved NORTHSTAR_DISTRO.md's open questions 1/2: Alpine has official first-class aarch64 Pi support (Arch does not, upstream), confirmed live via the real alpine-rpi-3.20.10-aarch64.tar.gz artifact (kernel/firmware/dtbs/overlays for the full current Pi hardware matrix, no from-scratch kernel build needed). Live-proved a root-less apk-tools-static rootfs bootstrap (24/24 packages, ~17MiB); found and named the real privilege boundary (chroot-based post-install scripts + qemu-user-static for aarch64-on-x86_64 + loop-mount image assembly all need real root, unavailable in this sandbox). Queued the full Phase 1 privileged build script (sudo-queue/76-build-emilyos-pi-image.sh) rather than working around the boundary with something fragile. Real phased plan (Phase 1 privileged build -> Phase 2 EmilyOS OpenRC service -> Phase 3 boot-test -> Phase 4 FLASH handoff -> Phase 5 package selection) in NORTHSTAR_DISTRO.md. Planning + one queued script only — no image built yet.

⚓ ☃
title: EmilyOS Alpine/Raspberry Pi distro pivot — Phase 0 scoping + root-less rootfs proof
